name: openkbs-snap
description: Chrome extension: annotate screenshots into issues, export a report the OpenKBS board can import.

scripts.check: for f in bg.js content.js console-hook.js panel.js popup.js lib/*.js; do node --check $f || exit 1; done && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8'))" && echo ok
